# Use Heidrun Code from a phone
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Connect Heidrun Code Mobile to the desktop application to use selected workspace controls from a phone.

## Connect a phone

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/heidrun_code_mobile/screens.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary/heidrun_code_mobile.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/settings/SettingsMobileAccessSection.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/auxiliary/mobile_website/src/mobile_app.ts -->

Enable mobile access in Settings and follow the pairing instructions shown there. Enter the pairing key on the phone; the phone then displays the available workspace and pane controls.

## Use phone controls

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/heidrun_code_mobile/screens.md -->
<!-- source: packages/auxiliary/mobile_website/src/mobile_app.ts -->

Use the bottom bar to move between the mobile screens. The pane screen provides the terminal, macro, and microphone controls available to the connected session.
